meta.home.title: Tap Timer: Tap the Clock at Exactly 5 Seconds | Free Game
meta.home.desc: Free online timing game: the clock is hidden, so tap it when you think 5 seconds have passed. Try the 5, 10 or 30 second challenge solo or with friends.
meta.party.title: Tap Timer Party: Pass-the-Phone Timing Game for Groups
meta.party.desc: A free party game on one phone: everyone tries to stop the hidden clock at the same goal time, then the reveal shows who was closest. For 2 to 8 players.
meta.online.title: Tap Timer Online: Multiplayer Stop-the-Clock Game
meta.online.desc: Play the hidden-clock timing game online with friends, each on your own phone. Share a room code or QR, play 1 to 10 rounds, and the closest total wins.
meta.howto.title: How to Play Tap Timer: Rules, Scoring & Tips
meta.howto.desc: Rules for the stop-the-clock game: how the hidden timer works, ratings from PERFECT to WAY OFF, every mode, and tips for getting closer to the goal.
meta.privacy.title: Website Privacy Policy | Tap Timer
meta.privacy.desc: How the Tap Timer website handles your information: browser storage, online rooms, server logs and Google ads.
meta.terms.title: Website Terms of Service | Tap Timer
meta.terms.desc: The rules for using the Tap Timer website: free play, online rooms, ads, the iPhone app, and our responsibilities.
meta.room.title: Join room {code} | Play Tap Timer Online
meta.room.desc: You've been invited to a Tap Timer room. Stop the hidden clock closest to the goal to win.

home.step1: 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Five is the classic.
home.step2: Tap to start. The clock disappears, so you have to count in your head.
home.step3: Tap when it feels right. We'll show your time to the hundredth of a second.
